def make(n, cell, marks):
 g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
 d=cell
 for r in range(d,n,d+1):
  if r<n:
   g[r]=[8]*n
   for c in range(n):g[c][r]=8
 for (i,j,v) in marks:g[i*(d+1)+d//2][j*(d+1)+d//2]=v
 return g

  for r in range(i*4,i*4+3):
   for c in range(j*4,j*4+3): assert o[r][c]==expected,(i,j,r,c,o[r][c],expected)
print('demo_verified')
